title: SPUMA-VACUI: Vacuum-Foam Substrate Dynamics — Constraint-Aligned Emergence with Near-Homogeneous Polarized Cavities
description: SPUMA-VACUI models a vacuum-foam substrate: noise-driven regional inflation, edge-sweeping, and near-homogeneous polarized cavities under two binding constraints (K1 vacuum discontinuity; K2 polarization-tension non-continuity). Includes the K1 critical-edge calibration (b_c = 0.1263±0.0002, corrected ratio R_edge = 1.841), the three cavity-size regimes with spectral translation, the T1 freeze-out battery, and the Companion-Bridge mapping (OQ3 closed by the W5 common-operator result: one operator, two clocks, no third scale; family-wide convention f_c = κ[rad/s]/π). Companion repositories: LIMEN-VACUI (protocol home), Emergence-SDF-Vault, CADENCE-SDF. Model-level claims with executed numerical protocols; no empirical cosmological claim is made.
